subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared inbound attachment metadata contract for agents, or keep Slack attachments represented only as placeholders and media path/type fields for now?
rationale: The current source gap is clear, but the durable fix affects the plugin SDK and cross-channel agent context shape, so automation should not choose the permanent API unilaterally.

options.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
options.body: Add a cross-channel InboundAttachments-style field while preserving existing MediaPath/MediaPaths and placeholder behavior for compatibility.

options.title: Keep Current Contract
options.body: Close or defer the structured metadata request and document that Slack exposes file IDs through placeholders plus downloaded media references only.

options.title: Prototype Slack-Only Metadata
options.body: Add a narrow Slack field first, accepting later migration risk if Discord and Telegram need a different shared shape.

recommendation.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel InboundAttachments-style field while preserving existing MediaPath/MediaPaths and placeholder behavior for compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent work tie him to the shared channel/media surfaces that would need the product/API decision.
